texts.preamble: M/S.Ar Bachawat Trading Pvt. Ltd vs Mrs.Amutha on 9 December, 2016 Author: M.M.Sundresh Bench: M.M.Sundresh In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 09.12.2016 Coram The Honourable Mr. Justice M.M.Sundresh Contempt Petition No.2326 of 2016 and Sub Application (Os) No.490 of 2016 M/s.AR Bachawat Trading Pvt. Ltd., Rep. By Mr.Dinesh, Authorised Signatory, No.27/5, Erulappan Street, Chennai 600 079. ...Pe Vs Mrs.Amutha, The Commissioner, Food and Safety, 5th Floor, Dms Building, 359, Anna Salai, Dms Campus, Teynampet, Chennai 600 006.
texts.arguments: 1 2.Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that though the respondent has complied with the similar orders passed in both interim as well as final, the present order has not been complied with. 3. Learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondent/contemnor submits that the goods have been seized by the police and thereafter, the same was handed over to the office of the respondent. Admittedly, the sale has been effected by the petitioner with respect to a product known as chewing tobacco. He further submitted that the report of the King Institute Food Analysis Laboratory reiterates the same. The Hon'ble Apex Court has held in S.L.P (C) No.16308 of 2007 that in such a case, a product which contains tobacco/nicotine would come under the purview of the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibitions & Restrictions On Sales) Regulations, 2011 and that all the connected writ petitions are likely to be posted before the appropriate court.
